calendar_selection_policy: Two complete consecutive UTC Monday-Sunday weeks, selected before inspecting these dates' market profiles; do not replace dates based on market outcomes or file sizes.
development_policy: Fit auxiliary parameters only on 2024-10-14 through 2024-10-20 before evaluation on 2024-10-21 through 2024-10-27. A model fitted using November data is not a strictly forward validation on this October development week.
preregistration_policy: Commit this configuration and its protocol before downloading or inspecting the selected market profiles. Archive-list metadata and HEAD size checks alone are permitted before commit.
event_test_policy: No auxiliary event-test dates. The parent study's 2024-11-05 through 2024-11-07 event test remains sealed; its configuration and splits are unchanged.
